```{r theme, echo=FALSE}
my_gt_theme <- function(gt_tbl) {
  # Grab number of rows of data from gt object
  n_rows <- nrow(gt_tbl$`_data`)
  
  gt_tbl %>%
    tab_options(
      data_row.padding = px(6),
      heading.align = 'center',
      column_labels.background.color = '#051C4A',
      heading.title.font.size = px(26),
      heading.subtitle.font.size = px(14),
      table_body.hlines.width = px(0)
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(
        color = '#051C4A', 
        weight = 'bold', 
        font = google_font('Inter')
      ),
      locations = cells_title(groups = 'title')
    ) 
}
```

```{r service across rural locations, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

rural_service <- dbGetQuery(dbcon, 
              "SUMMARIZE (
    SELECT distinct_fiber, coop_fiber, distinct_wireline
    FROM wireline_comp
    WHERE urbancoretype = 'Rural');") %>%
  select(column_name, min, max, avg, std) %>%
  mutate(across(c(min:std), ~round(as.numeric(.), 2))) %>%
  rename("service" = "column_name") %>%
  as_tibble()

rural_locs_served <- dbGetQuery(dbcon, "
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT location_id)                                   AS locs_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT location_id) FILTER (WHERE distinct_fiber > 0)    AS distinct_fiber,
    COUNT(DISTINCT location_id) FILTER (WHERE coop_fiber > 0)        AS coop_fiber,
    COUNT(DISTINCT location_id) FILTER (WHERE distinct_wireline > 0) AS distinct_wireline
  FROM wireline_comp
  WHERE urbancoretype = 'Rural';") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-locs_total, names_to = "service", values_to = "locs_served")

rural_service2 <- rural_service %>%
  left_join(rural_locs_served, by = "service") %>%
  mutate(pct_served = round(100 * locs_served / locs_total, 1)) %>%
  select(service, locs_total, locs_served, pct_served, min, max, avg, std) %>%
  mutate(service = recode(service,
                          distinct_wireline = "Any Wireline",
                          distinct_fiber    = "Any Fiber",
                          coop_fiber        = "Cooperative Fiber" ))
```

```{r percent of rural pop without high-speed wireline, echo=FALSE}

#calculate the total rural pop without wireline options 
rpop <- dbGetQuery(dbcon, "
WITH rural AS (
SELECT        
  DISTINCT (block_id),
  urbancoretype
  FROM wireline_comp
  WHERE urbancoretype ='Rural')
SELECT SUM(b.pop2023) AS pop
FROM staff_block_est b
INNER JOIN rural a ON a.block_id = b.block_id
  ;")
#convert that value to a vector
rpop_v <- as_vector(rpop$pop)

#calculate the total rural population with => 2 distinct wireline options 
rpop_no <- dbGetQuery(dbcon, "
WITH rural AS (
SELECT        
  DISTINCT (block_id),
  urbancoretype
  FROM wireline_comp
  WHERE urbancoretype = 'Rural' AND
  distinct_wireline =0)
SELECT SUM(b.pop2023) AS pop
FROM staff_block_est b
INNER JOIN rural a ON a.block_id = b.block_id
  ;")

#convert that value to a vector
rpopno_v <- as_vector(rpop_no$pop)

#calculate the percentage
rpopno_pct <- (rpopno_v/rpop_v)*100
```

```{r waffle plot fiber comp rurality, echo=FALSE}

#create a summary of the co-op fiber competition across population density
coop_fiber_comp <- dbGetQuery(dbcon, "SELECT urbancoretype, coop_fiber FROM wireline_comp WHERE urbancoretype IS NOT NULL AND urbancoretype != 'Water';") %>% 
  count(coop_fiber, urbancoretype) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = urbancoretype,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>% 
  rename("Metro" = `Metro core`, "Micro" = `Micro core`, "Small-town" = `Small town core`, "Providers" = coop_fiber) %>%
  select(Providers, Metro, Micro, `Small-town`, Rural)


rurality_levels <- c("Metro", "Micro", "`Small-town`", "Rural")

#create a summary of the wired competition across population density
wired_comp <- dbGetQuery(dbcon, "SELECT urbancoretype, distinct_wireline FROM wireline_comp WHERE urbancoretype IS NOT NULL AND urbancoretype != 'Water';") %>% 
  count(distinct_wireline, urbancoretype) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = urbancoretype,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>% 
  rename("Metro" = `Metro core`, "Micro" = `Micro core`, "Small-town" = `Small town core`, "Providers" = distinct_wireline) %>%
  select(Providers, Metro, Micro, `Small-town`, Rural)

co_op_total_comp <- wired_comp %>%
  left_join(coop_fiber_comp, by = "Providers", suffix = c("", "_coop"))  %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))

areas <- c("Metro", "Micro", "Small-town", "Rural")

waffle_summary <- lapply(areas, function(a) {
  coop_col   <- paste0(a, "_coop")
  total      <- sum(co_op_total_comp[[coop_col]])
  zero_coop  <- co_op_total_comp[[coop_col]][co_op_total_comp$Providers == 0]
  pct_filled <- round((total - zero_coop) / total * 100)

  dplyr::tibble(
    area   = a,
    status = c("Co-op present", "No co-op"),
    pct    = c(pct_filled, 100 - pct_filled)
  )
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()

# Expand to one row per square (100 per area), then run through waffle_iron per area
waffle_data <- waffle_summary %>%
  uncount(pct) %>%
  group_by(area) %>%
  group_modify(~ waffle_iron(.x, aes_d(group = status), rows = 10)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(area = factor(area,
                          levels = c("Metro", "Micro", "Small-town", "Rural"))) %>%
  arrange(area)

p <- ggplot(waffle_data, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = group)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~area, nrow = 1, strip.position = "bottom") +
  coord_equal() +
  MetBrewer::scale_fill_met_d("Hiroshige", direction = 1) +
  labs(title = "Co-op Presence Across Population Density",
       subtitle = "Share of locations where at least one cooperative provider offers fiber Internet access",
       fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

```


```{r co-op fed funding summary}

progs <- dbGetQuery(con,"SELECT * FROM raw_fcc.bfm_program_data;")


electric_fund <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT program_id, provider_id,
         string_agg(DISTINCT brand_name, ', ' ORDER BY brand_name) AS brand_name,
         project_id,
         SUM(locs_planned) AS locs_planned
  FROM (
    SELECT program_id,
           providerid AS provider_id,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(brandname), ''), project) AS brand_name,
           project_id,
           loc_plan AS locs_planned
    FROM staging_bfm.bfm_fiber_electric

    UNION ALL

    SELECT program_id,
           provider_id,
           brand_name,
           project_id,
           planned AS locs_planned
    FROM staging_bfm.bfmbl_fiber_electric
  ) AS combined
  GROUP BY program_id, provider_id, project_id
  ORDER BY program_id, provider_id, project_id;") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  left_join(y = progs %>% select(program_id, program_name, program_acronym), by = "program_id") %>%
  mutate(coop_type = 'Electric')


telephone_fund <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT program_id, provider_id,
         string_agg(DISTINCT brand_name, ', ' ORDER BY brand_name) AS brand_name,
         project_id,
         SUM(locs_planned) AS locs_planned

  FROM (
    SELECT 
      program_id, 
      providerid AS provider_id, 
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(brandname), ''), project) AS brand_name, 
      project_id,
      loc_plan AS locs_planned
      FROM staging_bfm.bfm_fiber_telephone
    UNION ALL
    SELECT program_id, provider_id, brand_name, project_id, planned AS locs_planned FROM staging_bfm.bfmbl_fiber_telephone
  )
  GROUP BY program_id, provider_id, project_id
  ORDER BY program_id, provider_id, project_id;") %>%
  as_tibble() %>% left_join(y = progs %>% select(program_id, program_name, program_acronym), by = "program_id") %>%
  mutate(coop_type = 'Telephone')

other_fund <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
      program_id, 
      providerid AS provider_id, 
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(brandname), ''), project) AS brand_name, 
      project_id,
      loc_plan AS locs_planned
      FROM staging_bfm.bfm_fiber_othercoop
  GROUP BY program_id, providerid, project_id, brand_name, loc_plan
  ORDER BY program_id, providerid, project_id, brand_name, loc_plan;") %>%
  as_tibble() %>% left_join(y = progs %>% select(program_id, program_name, program_acronym), by = "program_id") %>%
  mutate(coop_type = 'Tel-Elec')




#How many providers/projects/locations have been funded?
funds_by_coop_type <- bind_rows(electric_fund, telephone_fund, other_fund) %>% 
  summarise(provider_count = n_distinct(provider_id), project_count = n_distinct(project_id), locs_planned = sum(locs_planned), .by = c(coop_type, program_id, program_name, program_acronym)) %>%
  arrange(program_id, coop_type)

#check that project_id count is correct
#electric_fund %>% subset(program_id == "10") %>% select(project_id) %>% n_distinct()

#how many federal programs have cooperatives received funding to build fiber?
total_programs <- n_distinct(funds_by_coop_type$program_id)

#how many providers overall, by type, have been funded?
provider_fund_by_type <- bind_rows(electric_fund, telephone_fund, other_fund) %>% 
  summarise(provider_count = n_distinct(provider_id), .by = "coop_type")

#how many providers total have received funding to build fiber?
providers_funded <- bind_rows(electric_fund, telephone_fund, other_fund) %>%
  summarise(provider_count = n_distinct(provider_id)) %>% pull(provider_count)
```

```{r legend}
# Helper: colored swatch + label
swatch <- function(color, label) {
  paste0(
    "<span style='display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;",
    "background:", color, ";opacity:0.7;border:1px solid ", color, ";",
    "margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle;'></span>", label
  )
}

grp_e  <- swatch("#051C4A", "Electric Cooperatives")
grp_t  <- swatch("#F48156", "Telephone Cooperatives")
grp_te <- swatch("#53CCDD", "Telephone-Electric Cooperatives")
grp_f <- swatch("#545454", "Fiber Cooperatives")

leaflet() %>%
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = "https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=cb1_2h1o_1_ac4f6a1f67f7a54987f0abee",
    attribution = 'Map tiles by <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>, <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>') %>%
  setView(lng = -97.8, lat = 41.1, zoom = 4) %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = e_footprint,
    fillColor = "#051C4A", color = "#051C4A", weight = 1, fillOpacity = 0.5,
    label = ~lapply(label_html, htmltools::HTML),
    popup = ~popup_html,
    group = grp_e) %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = t_footprint,
    fillColor = "#F48156", color = "#F48156", weight = 1, fillOpacity = 0.5,
    label = ~lapply(label_html, htmltools::HTML),
    popup = ~popup_html,
    group = grp_t) %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = te_footprint,
    fillColor = "#53CCDD", color = "#53CCDD", weight = 1, fillOpacity = 0.5,
    label = ~lapply(label_html, htmltools::HTML),
    popup = ~popup_html,
    group = grp_te) %>%
   addPolygons(
    data = f_footprint,
    fillColor = "#545454", color = "#545454", weight = 1, fillOpacity = 0.5,
    label = ~lapply(label_html, htmltools::HTML),
    popup = ~popup_html,
    group = grp_f) %>%
   # State boundaries: added last so they sit on top
  addPolylines(
    data = states_sf,
    color = "#333333", weight = .5, opacity = 0.8,
    options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE),  # lets clicks/hovers pass through to the co-op polygons
    group = "State boundaries") %>%
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c(grp_e, grp_t, grp_te, grp_f),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft")
```

```{r}
#get tech x state cooperative stats
coop_tech_state <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM analysis_summary.coop_techstate_summary;") %>% rename("NAME" = "state_name") %>% mutate(locs_claimed = as.numeric(locs_claimed)) %>%
select(NAME, tech_name, pop_claimed) %>%
pivot_wider(names_from = "tech_name", values_from = pop_claimed)  %>%
right_join(st_boundaries, by = "NAME") %>%
select(NAME:`Licensed-by-Rule Terrestrial Fixed Wireless`, INTPTLAT, INTPTLON) %>%
 mutate(
    lon = as.double(INTPTLON),
    lat = as.double(INTPTLAT)) %>%
 st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),crs = 4326) %>%
  rename("Copper" = "Copper Wire",
         "Fiber" = "Optical Carrier; Fiber to the Premises",
         "Cable" = "Coaxial Cable; HFC",
         "LFW" = "Licensed Terrestrial Fixed Wireless",
         "UFW" = "Unlicensed Terrestrial Fixed Wireless",
         "LBRFW" = "Licensed-by-Rule Terrestrial Fixed Wireless")

coords <- st_coordinates(coop_tech_state)

chartdata <- coop_tech_state %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(
    Cable,
    Copper,
    Fiber,
    LFW,
    LBRFW,
    UFW
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0))) %>%
  as.matrix()

colors <- c(
  Cable  = "#f48156",
  Copper = "#1f8290",
  Fiber  = "#fbcc76",
  LFW    = "#5b73ae",
  LBRFW  = "#53ccdd",
  UFW    = "#cdf266"
)

#Set up the pop-up formatting
popup_html <- apply(chartdata, 1, function(row) {
  paste0(
    "<b>", names(row), ":</b> ",
    format(row, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
    collapse = "<br>"
  )
})

# prepend the state name as a title, since html popups replace the whole popup
popup_html <- paste0(
  "<div style='font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; margin-bottom:4px;'>",
  coop_tech_state$NAME,
  "</div>",
  popup_html
)

#create the map
leaflet() %>%
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = "https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=cb1_2h1o_1_ac4f6a1f67f7a54987f0abee",
    attribution = 'Map tiles by <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>, <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>'
  ) %>%
  setView(lng = -97.8, lat = 41.1, zoom = 4) %>%
  addMinicharts(
    lng = coords[, "X"],
    lat = coords[, "Y"],
    type = "pie",
    chartdata = chartdata,
    colorPalette = unname(colors),
    width = 20,
    legend = TRUE,
    legendPosition = "topleft",
    popup = popupArgs(html = popup_html)
  )%>%
   # State boundaries: added last so they sit on top
  addPolylines(
    data = states_sf,
    color = "#333333", weight = .5, opacity = 0.8,
    options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE),  # lets clicks/hovers pass through to the co-op polygons
    group = "State boundaries")
```

```{r funding table}
funds_by_coop_type %>%
  arrange(program_acronym) %>%
  select(coop_type, program_acronym, provider_count:locs_planned) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "program_acronym") %>%
  tab_row_group(
    label = md("**Electric Cooperatives**"),
    rows = coop_type == "Electric",
    id = "electric"
  ) %>%
  tab_row_group(
    label = md("**Telephone Cooperatives**"),
    rows = coop_type == "Telephone",
    id = "telephone"
  ) %>%
  tab_row_group(
    label = md("**Other Cooperatives**"),
    rows = coop_type == "Tel-Elec",
    id = "tel-elec"
  ) %>%
  fmt_integer(columns = provider_count:locs_planned) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = program_acronym) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = provider_count:locs_planned) %>%
  row_group_order(groups = c("electric", "telephone", "tel-elec" )) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = coop_type) %>%
   cols_label(
    provider_count = "Providers",
    project_count = "Projects",
    locs_planned = "Locations"
  ) %>%
```
